regeneration_risk: godot/tools/import-web-assets.mjs rewrites game.json from the web build (unitModels from army/unit-visuals.js): re-running it reverts the catalog to the old *27 models
godot/.github/workflows/drenovar-ios.yml runs fetch-web84-assets.mjs + import-web-assets.mjs before export: a CI build would ship the old catalog unless the importer gets an override
godot/tools/verify_drenovar_asset_snapshot.py --require-complete hashes game.json among the 732 inventoried originals: an edited game.json is reported as mismatched
existing army GLBs and the shared infantry PNGs are pinned in assets/original-assets.json and tools/web84-sources.json: never overwrite them in place

controller.movement_owner: server path + startsAt/arrivesAt -> landscape.gd present_armies: army anchor p = along_route(path, (now-startsAt)/(arrivesAt-startsAt)) on terrain; heading from +-250 ms look-ahead; member = p + rotated slot offset (formations.gd); clips are in place (no root motion: Hips/HorseRoot translate only in Y in Walk/Run)
controller.facing: model +Z forward; march: facing = route heading; fighting: each member faces the army anchor p (where the target stands); parade: +Z; training: PI
controller.visibility: army drawn only if anchor p + 1 m is inside the camera frustum; hidden when world camera zoom > 132; at most 6 new soldiers instantiated per frame; hidden actors cached 10 s
controller.polling: client GET /state every 0.8 s while an own march exists (5 s otherwise); between polls server time = unix ms + offset from the last state; status and events change only on a poll

play_animation.search: for each AnimationPlayer: first clip in get_animation_list() whose lowercase name CONTAINS the preferred lowercase string; if none, the LAST clip containing the fallback string
play_animation.list_order: get_animation_list() is sorted by case-sensitive code point (verified 4.6.3): 'A'..'Z' < '_' < 'a'..'z', so 'Attack' < 'AttackHeavy' < 'Attack_Windup' < 'attack_low'
play_animation.looped_call: phase < 0: animation.loop_mode = LOOP_LINEAR (set on the shared resource), play(clip, 0.16 s crossfade), then seek(start_fraction * length); start_fraction = fposmod(slot_index * 0.381966, 1)
play_animation.scrubbed_call: phase >= 0: play(clip) without crossfade if the clip changed, pause(), seek(clamp(phase, 0, 0.999) * length, update = true)
play_animation.speed: speed_scale is never changed: Walk/Idle play at 1.0 regardless of route speed

battle.event_format: [at_ms_after_battleAt, kind, unitId, index, hp] or {at, kind, unitId, index, hp}
battle.member_key: unitId:index, index = per-unit member index of formations.field_slots (server indices, max 24 represented members)
battle.kinds: soldier_attack = this member strikes the target at `at` (target plays Hit from `at`); any other kind = the creature hits this member at `at` (code only distinguishes antler_charge for the creature Alert clip; the synthetic tests use the creature spec.ability: antler_charge Velkor, pounce Tenerys); hp = member hp after the hit, 0 = death
battle.fallen: army.fallen [[unitId, index]] = lying dead from the start of the fight (death phase 1.0 when no hit event)
battle.priority: death > hit (elapsed - last_hit < 400) > attack (elapsed in [at-490, at+510]) > pvp loop (1000 ms) > idle
battle.death_phase: (elapsed - hit) / 700, then held at 0.999 for the rest of the fight
battle.overlap: if two soldier_attack windows of one member overlap, the later event in the list wins (clip restarts from its window phase)
battle.spread: spread = smoothstep(0, 700 ms, elapsed): side * (1 + 0.22 spread), rear + spread * (4.0 ranged | 2.5 others); city: lerp to a circle radius 7.5 (mounted) / 4.8 m around p
battle.creature: target creature at its encounter position (= path end), faces route heading + PI; for a hit event on a member: creature window [at-560, at+430], Alert [at-560, at-260] only for antler_charge, Attack phase (elapsed-at+260)/690; for soldier_attack: creature Hit [at, at+420]
battle.advance_knowledge: the attack window starts 490 ms and the projectile 260 ms BEFORE `at`; this only works if the battle timeline arrives before `at`. Server behaviour is not verifiable here (server code not in the session). Synthetic test (poll 800 ms, latency 120 ms): full timeline at the first fighting poll -> 40/46 attack windows shown, 16/20 projectiles; progressive reveal -> 18/46 windows shown only from phase 0.62-0.82, 0/20 projectiles. The fighting status itself is learned up to ~0.9 s after arrivesAt, so the first window can start mid-swing

projectile.who: slot.ranged = training_building RNG-01 (ENG-03, ENG-04, also ENG-10)
projectile.node: MeshInstance3D 'Arrow' added as child of the unit model root on first shot, reused: CylinderMesh radius 0.023 m, 5 segments, unshaded #ffd480, no shadow
projectile.window: visible while clip == attack and elapsed in [at-260, at]; phase_p = (elapsed - at + 260) / 260
projectile.start: a = unit.global_position + (0, 1.35, 0) world (body axis, NOT a hand or socket; = (0, 1.174, 0) in model units at scale 1.15)
projectile.end: b = army anchor p + (0, 1.45, 0) (the creature stands at p)
projectile.path: tip = lerp(a, b, p) + UP * 0.6 * sin(pi p); tail = same at max(0, p - 0.13); shaft drawn between tail and tip (length grows to 13 % of the path)
projectile.count: one shaft per unit, one flight per soldier_attack event; arrival exactly at `at` = impact time
projectile.handoff_in_attack_clip: release at attack phase 0.23 (at - 260 ms); the model's arrow/bolt must leave the hand/stock on that frame. Seamless position/orientation needs either the nocked arrow placed on the body axis at 1.174 m (model units) at release, or a stage-11 change of draw_arrow to start from a socket bone (proposed bone: 'ProjectileSocket', +Z = flight direction)

optional_unused_now: Shield_Block (ENG-01, ENG-02, ENG-04: present today, never requested)

clips.loop_rule: first and last key identical; controller forces LOOP_LINEAR; length = whole cycles

scrubbed_clips.Attack: mapped to 1000 ms; recommended length 1.0 s (31 keys at 30 fps) so clip time = real time
scrubbed_clips.Hit: mapped to 400 ms; recommended length 0.4 s (13 keys)
scrubbed_clips.Death: mapped to 700 ms then frozen on the last 0.1 %; recommended length 0.7 s (22 keys); last frame = final lying pose on flat ground

transitions.into_attack_hit_death: instant pose switch (no crossfade): Attack/Hit frame 0 should match the Idle (or Idle_Ready) silhouette
transitions.out_of_attack_hit: 0.16 s crossfade into Idle at a random phase: last frames should end close to Idle
transitions.walk_idle: 0.16 s crossfade on arrival/departure; Walk frame 0 phase is random per slot

naming_rules: controller substrings: walk, idle, run, attack, hit, death (case-insensitive)
an extra clip that contains one of them must START with the matching base name so it sorts after it: Walk_Start > Walk, Idle_Ready > Idle
never put a keyword inside another word that sorts earlier: Bridle (idle), Sidewalk/Cakewalk (walk), Whittle/Chitin (hit), Grunt/Prune/Brunt (run), Trot_To_Walk (walk, T < W)
the drill name must not be a substring of another clip (fallback takes the LAST match)
do not export a RESET clip (import_rest_as_RESET=false today)
exact names above are required by qa_warriors.gd (clips.has)

proposed_extra_names.note: none of these is called by the current controller; stage 11 decides which to wire

ranged.after_release: 0.23-1.00 (770 ms) for follow-through / crossbow re-span; after 1.00 the controller returns to Idle

attack_timeline.crossbow_states: bolt on stock in Idle and 0.00-0.23; bolt gone 0.23-reload; reload must fit 0.23-1.00 of the window or be shown by the drill (armory) only; visibility via bone scale (glTF scale keys) since mesh visibility is not animatable in glTF

locomotion.route_speed: not known by the client in advance: speed = path length / (arrivesAt - startsAt); server formula unavailable (unit speed stat 3-8 is not used by the client)
locomotion.measured_mismatch_at_1_2_mps: cycle/path -61.7 % infantry, -55.1 % horse; planted-foot slide 0.23-0.37 m per contact on straight ground, up to 2.7 m for rear ranks in a 60 degree turn (rigid formation rotation)
locomotion.recommendation: author Walk (and horse gaits) for a stated reference speed and record it in the stage report and in a sidecar JSON next to the GLB, e.g. ENG-01-spearman60-lod2.locomotion.json {"Walk": {"speed_mps_model": v, "cycle_s": T}} (top-level glTF extras are NOT imported by Godot 4.6.3 - checked on ENG-01, no metadata on the imported scene); stage 11 must scale AnimationPlayer.speed_scale = route_speed / (v * 1.15) or pick Walk/Run/Trot/Gallop by speed - landscape.gd change, not possible from the assets alone
locomotion.slopes: no foot IK: on a 0.17 grade the uphill toe joint sinks up to 0.10 m below terrain (sole ~0.14 m), on a 0.20 down-grade feet hover; actor stays vertical

skeleton.mounted_hierarchy: HorseRoot (rot -90 X) -> HorseBack -> {HorseNeck->HorseHead/Ears, FrontL/RScapula->Upper->Knee->Hoof, rider Hips->...}; HindL/RHip and TailBase are children of HorseRoot
skeleton.skins: one skin, all meshes skinned (no BoneAttachment3D, no sockets, no rigid child meshes today)
skeleton.imported_tree: root Node3D (file name) -> glTF scene root Node3D -> Skeleton3D -> skinned MeshInstance3D; AnimationPlayer under root, root_node '..', single default library
skeleton.bone_names_used_by_code: none (landscape.gd/main.gd never reference bones); names are required by the QA telemetry (qa_eng_squad_capture.gd, foot_slide_report.py): Foot/Toe/Hoof/Hips/Head/Hand
skeleton.item_bones: allowed (stage 07), recorded by telemetry as item_bones with position+quaternion; proposed names: Weapon_R, Shield_L, Bow_L, BowString, ProjectileSocket, Crossbow, Bolt, Quiver, BoltCase, Lance_R

axes_and_units.origin: ground point between the feet (horse: between the hooves); controller places the origin on terrain and rotates about Y only
axes_and_units.blender: Blender -Y forward, +Z up, right hand on -X; glTF export +Y up gives +Z forward

screen_size.world_camera: perspective fov 43, tilt 0.88 rad, distance = zoom from (x, 1, z); battle 68, closest 15
screen_size.armory_px: 170-190 px figure height incl. weapon in the 442x258 SubViewport (camera fitted to the mesh AABB, a tall spear/lance makes the body smaller)
screen_size.note: world numbers for terrain near y = 1; over higher ground the camera is closer (it aims at y = 1), soldiers appear larger and at zoom 15 a followed army on terrain above ~6.3 m leaves the frustum and is not drawn

formations.parade: INF-01 left / RNG-01 right columns of 12, lateral (i%3-1)*1.05 m, rows 1.45 m, columns 4.5 m; cavalry pairs +-1.2 m, rows 4 m; offsets x0.77 when no garrison district (0.81 m lateral, 3.08 m cavalry rows); scale 1.0

clearances.infantry_half_width_note: 1.45 m lateral spacing; 0.6 m per side leaves 0.25 m for weapon swing between neighbours
clearances.note: horse at x1.15 leaves 4 cm between rows; parade cavalry rows 3.08 m < horse length 3.18 m (overlap today)

materials.rule: warrior_visual.gd lower-cases material.resource_name (= glTF material name) and tests in this order; first match wins
materials.no_keyword: material kept as imported (still flagged as prepared); existing examples ENG01_red, ENG01_dark, ENG01_bowstring, forgeShield, forgeShaft, forgeHeraldry, horseHoof
materials.naming: <UNIT>_<keyword>[<Detail>] with exactly one keyword, e.g. ENG02_cloth, ENG02_leather, ENG02_steel, ENG02_shieldpaint, ENG06_horsecoat, ENG06_horsehair, ENG06_eye; beware hidden keywords (environment -> iron, hedge -> edge, marigold -> gold)
materials.texture_filter: set to LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS_ANISOTROPIC for every warrior material (needs mipmaps)

import.auto_lod: Godot generates 4-8 LOD levels per surface (meshoptimizer); level used = coarsest with projected edge error <= 1 px (mesh_lod_threshold 1.0, lod_bias 1.0)
import.textures_existing: infantry external PNG: lossless, no mipmaps; knight/scout extracted JPG/PNG: lossless with mipmaps
import.textures_recommended: external textures next to the GLB, committed .import with compress/mode=2 (VRAM), mipmaps/generate=true, normal maps compress/normal_map=1, detect_3d off

qa_warriors: preview and field load as PackedScene
at least one surface; every BaseMaterial3D gets the drenovar_warrior_surface meta
at least one material with albedo_texture and normal_enabled
clips contain exactly Idle, Walk and the catalog drill

budgets.textures: <= 1024x1024 albedo/normal/ORM sets: infantry <= 2 sets, mounted <= 3 sets; VRAM-compressed with mipmaps

silhouette_checks.battle_camera: world zoom 68: infantry 16-17 px tall, head ~3 px; must still separate helmet/hat/hood/cap shapes and shoulder lines at Godot LOD of that distance
silhouette_checks.close_camera: world zoom 15: infantry ~84 px, knight ~154 px

acceptance_proposed.source: task text (audit 1005: speed <= 2 %, hoof <= 5 % leg) and FOUNDER_REQUIREMENTS 'match stride and ground contact to actual travel speed'; no numeric project criterion exists in code or QA
acceptance_proposed.turns: reported separately; rigid formation rotation in landscape.gd moves outer members sideways regardless of animation
acceptance_proposed.slopes: report foot penetration/hover from telemetry (no IK in controller)

capture_tool.script: godot/project/qa_eng_squad_capture.gd (SceneTree, excluded from export by qa_*)
capture_tool.outputs: DIR/frames/f_NNNNN.png|jpg, DIR/telemetry.json (header: route, events, timeline, clip tables, rest bones; frames: camera, client status, per member clip/animation/phase, bones (foot/toe/hoof with terrain height), item bones, attachments, Arrow tip/tail, creature clip)

web_export: none in this repository: export_presets.cfg has only the iOS preset; tools/*.mjs import FROM the web build (fetch-web84-assets.mjs, import-web-assets.mjs, capture-source-manifest.mjs) and run test servers; no Web preset or web asset export exists
